scope: inspect processed matrix structure and exact metadata joins; descriptive fixed zero/additive/repeated-pair metrics only if per-replicate columns preserved; otherwise reject repeat analysis
genes: all unique finite source-provided genes, with exclusions recorded; no response-selected gene panel
strata: separate each nominal time 0,3,6,9,12,24 and reported A/B/C labels; no pooling as extra biological replicates
processing: source log2 CPM; no count renormalization or inversion; source plate covariate adjustment retained and disclosed
